exchanges.speaker: leonidas
exchanges.line: Better well than not at all.

exchanges.speaker: dienekes
exchanges.line: Aye, and not a single man will cry out in fear.

exchanges.speaker: leonidas
exchanges.line: We are not the first to die for Sparta.

exchanges.speaker: dienekes
exchanges.line: Nor the last. But we shall be the last to do it with pride.

exchanges.speaker: leonidas
exchanges.line: What is a man, if he cannot die with honor?

exchanges.speaker: dienekes
exchanges.line: A coward, and no better than the beasts that roam the land.

exchanges.speaker: leonidas
exchanges.line: Then let the world remember us as we were: unbroken, unyielding, and free.

exchanges.speaker: dienekes
exchanges.line: And if the world forgets, let the earth remember our bones.

exchanges.speaker: dienekes
exchanges.line: Do you fear what comes after?

exchanges.speaker: leonidas
exchanges.line: No. I fear what comes before.

exchanges.speaker: dienekes
exchanges.line: Then let us make sure the before is worthy of the after.

exchanges.speaker: leonidas
exchanges.line: Agreed. And let the after be silence.

exchanges.speaker: dienekes
exchanges.line: And let the before be legend.

exchanges.speaker: leonidas
exchanges.line: And let the world know we did not run.

exchanges.speaker: dienekes
exchanges.line: Then let it be said: they stood, and the earth shook.

exchanges.speaker: leonidas
exchanges.line: And let the stars remember the light we gave them.
